item.title: Tech Weekly | 2026 W13
item.description:
This weekly post collects notable tech news from curated public RSS feeds and is updated daily.

2026-03-28

How Google Does It: An inside look at cybersecurity

Source: Google Blog Technology

English Summary: Learn how Google approaches some of today’s most pressing security topics, challenges and concerns, straight from Google experts.

Link: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud/how-google-does-it-security-series/

STADLER reshapes knowledge work at a 230-year-old company

Source: OpenAI Blog

English Summary: Learn how STADLER uses ChatGPT to transform knowledge work, saving time and accelerating productivity across 650 employees.

Link: https://openai.com/index/stadler

Why SoftBank’s new $40B loan points to a 2026 OpenAI IPO

Source: TechCrunch

English Summary: Wall Street giants JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs are extending a 12-month, unsecured loan to the Japanese conglomerate.

Link: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/27/why-softbanks-new-40b-loan-points-to-a-2026-openai-ipo/

Physical Intelligence is reportedly in talks to raise $1 billion, again

Source: TechCrunch

English Summary: The deal would effectively double the company’s $5.6 billion valuation in just four months.

Link: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/27/physical-intelligence-is-reportedly-in-talks-to-raise-1-billion-again/

European Commission confirms cyberattack after hackers claim data breach

Source: TechCrunch

English Summary: The European Union’s top executive body has confirmed a cyberattack after hackers reportedly stole reams of data from the European Commission’s cloud storage.

Link: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/27/european-commission-confirms-cyberattack-after-hackers-claim-data-breach/

How we use Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) to turn Workflows code into visual diagrams

Source: Cloudflare Blog

English Summary: Workflows are now visualized via step diagrams in the dashboard. Here’s how we translate your TypeScript code into a visual representation of the workflow.

Link: https://blog.cloudflare.com/workflow-diagrams/

Iranian hackers claim breach of FBI director Kash Patel’s personal email account

Source: TechCrunch

English Summary: Handala, a pro-Iranian hacking group allegedly working for Iran’s government, published emails it said were taken from the Gmail account of FBI director Kash Patel.

Link: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/27/iranian-hackers-claim-breach-of-fbi-director-kash-patels-personal-email-account/

Apple says no one using Lockdown Mode has been hacked with spyware

Source: TechCrunch

English Summary: The tech giant’s claim that it has not seen any successful spyware attacks targeting Apple devices with Lockdown Mode enabled comes amid a leak of hacking tools targeting users running devices with older software.

Link: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/27/apple-says-no-one-using-lockdown-mode-has-been-hacked-with-spyware/
